test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: According to the contributor, the parents are strangely careless and unscientific in giving names to children because ________.

options.text: they do it without considering the business point of view
they do it without discussing it with their relatives and friends
they do it without considering the actual meaning of the name
they do it without considering the latter’s interest in it

solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e. they do it without considering the business point of view.
